phase_name: Land the Declaration Behind a Two-Arm Live Falsification

objectives.description: Capture pre-state baseline (manifest keys, checked-out branch)
Run disarmed baseline --dry-run probe and keep output
Refusal arm: declare integration_branch=main, worktree_isolation=off; confirm off_integration_branch refusal
Admit arm: declare integration_branch=dev/m7-ladder-continuation; confirm armed admit (or dirty_primary_tree)
Attempt scoped commit of .claude-extensions.json and record gitignore skip

notes: Admit arm returned dirty_primary_tree (sibling task 987's own file_scope paths), treated as branch-arm PASS per plan's own contingency item. Verification (verify-touched.sh, narrowed per Batch Gate Deferral) re-run detached with a kill -0 waiter after the harness's prior auto-backgrounding: 28 passed, 9 failed (1 EXPECTED, 8 NEW), 2 skipped of 39 suites. test-batch-admission-lib.sh (the suite directly subject to this task's edit) PASSED. All 8 NEW failures trace to one pre-existing, unrelated root cause -- this repo's core extension source_dir resolves to an external source store (~/.config/nvim/agent-system/extensions/core), so no local agent-system/extensions/core tree exists under the project root, and several suites hardcode that project-root-relative path. Recorded via issue-record.sh (class verification-environment, severity minor). Phase closed COMPLETED on this evidence.
